## Services

- Business Process Automation (N8N, Zapier, Make, custom APIs)
- Custom Website Development (React, Shopify, CMS)
- Social Media Growth & Content (Instagram, Reels, Shorts)
- Paid Advertising (Meta, TikTok, Google Ads)
- Search Engine Optimization (SEO)
- Strategic Brand Design (logo, identity, style guides)
- Shopify Store Development & E-commerce Automation
- Influencer Marketing Campaign Management
- AI Agents & WhatsApp Chatbot Integration
- Email Marketing Automations

## Pricing

- Starter: $149/mo — Manual content creation and publishing
- Growth: $299/mo — Paid ads + 30-day content system
- Smart Scale: $599/mo — Automation, website, AI lead flows
- Dominate AI: $1,499/mo — Full-stack enterprise automation
